PgvectorStoreAdapter — SemanticMemoryPort backed by PostgreSQL + pgvector.

Compile with -d:withPostgres to activate (links libpq). Without the flag the module exports only a stub type and pure helpers.

Schema: donkey_memories — flat table: user_id, kind, content, embedding vector(4096), hash, chunk_index, offset, created_at, meta JSONB

All I/O is fallible (database can fail) and returns ResultT, string. Operations are chained via >>= (railway-oriented programming).

Usage example: let hits = adapter.search(userId, query, limit).valueOr: log.error("search: " & error) @

The >>= operator chains fallible operations: openDb >>= ensureSchema >>= storeChunk
